Coram : ARUN MISHRA*, S. ABDUL NAZEER, M.R. SHAH
Hindu Succession Act, 1956 – s.6 as amended by Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005 – Interpretation of – Held: The provisions contained in substituted s.6 of the Hindu Succession Act, 1956 confer status of coparcener on the daughter born before or after amendment in the same – The effect of the amendment is that a daughter is made coparcener, with effect from the date of amendment i.e. 09.09.2005 and she can claim partition also, which is a necessary concomitant of the coparcenary – s.6(1) recognises a Joint Hindu family governed by Mitakshara law
Decision Date : 11-08-2020 | Case No : DIARYNO AND DIARYYR No. 32601/2018 | Disposal Nature : Directions issued | Direction Issue : Reference answered | Bench : 3 Judges
